sources.title: Image captioning · Hugging Face
sources.snippet: Image captioning Image captioning is the task of predicting a caption for a given image. Common real world applications of it include aiding visually impaired people that can help them navigate through different situations. Therefore, image captioning helps to improve content accessibility for people by describing images to them.
